Tutoring from primary school through to the end of high school. Solid basics, and help when exams are the goal. The work is set for that student.
The aim is the moment it clicks, often enough that they start studying on their own.
Small groups, and room to teach one student at a time
Help for school tests, and for entrance exams
Meetings with parents, so you know how it's going
A course for the year they're in, and for the exam they're facing.
